summary: template lookup parameters: custom comment and variable delimiters, convert_data, jinja2_native, template_vars for extra variables, and trim_blocks.
questions: How do I pass extra variables to the template lookup?
How do I change Jinja delimiters for the template lookup?
How do I stop the template lookup converting YAML output to data?

answer_card.title: template lookup parameters
answer_card.answer_md:
- `template_vars` (dict, 2.3+): extra variables for templating
- `variable_start_string` / `variable_end_string` (`{{` / `}}`, 2.8+)
- `comment_start_string` / `comment_end_string` (`{#` / `#}`, 2.12+)
- `convert_data` (default true): convert YAML results to data; false leaves strings untouched (exclusive with `jinja2_native`)
- `jinja2_native` (2.11+): use Jinja2 native types; no effect if global `jinja2_native` is false
- `trim_blocks` (default true, 2.19+): remove the first newline after a block
